02 About me

An eye for design.
A mind for code.

I study Computer Science at NUML and explore graphic design through personal projects. My work spans beauty campaigns, fashion layouts, and small UI experiments.

I care about clear type, consistent layouts, and details that make a design easy to use.

Tools
  • Figma
  • Illustrator
  • Photoshop
  • Canva
My process

From idea to detail.

  1. 01.

    Define.

    Set the audience, message, and goal.

  2. 02.

    Design.

    Build a clear style with type, color, and layout.

  3. 03.

Beauty & skincare · Independent concept

Jenpharm 2.0

Social media design and stationery for a skincare concept.

Brief.

Create a consistent skincare campaign across social posts, stories, and print cards. Use one palette to connect product offers and brand messages.

Design choices.

Teal headings and mint backgrounds keep the products clear. Warm accents highlight offers. Botanical details connect the stationery to the campaign.

Next steps.

Shorten the promotional copy and check legibility on phones. Product claims need verification before publication.

Fashion & lifestyle · Independent concept

Ma’wa Wears

Fashion lookbook design, stationery, and a responsive website concept.

Brief.

Give a modest-fashion collection a consistent style across posters, social posts, print cards, and website mockups.

Design choices.

Warm neutrals frame the clothing. Serif headlines set a clear reading order. The same colors and type carry through the lookbook and website.

Next steps.

Replace placeholder copy and test a working storefront prototype. The current screens are visual concepts.
